description: Validate a 17-character VIN via the ISO 3779 / NHTSA weighted mod-11 check digit at position 9, and split it into its World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI), Vehicle Descriptor Section (VDS), and Vehicle Identifier Section (VIS). Does not decode make, model, or model year.

vin.description: The 17-character VIN, with or without spaces

name: validate_vin
